Meta.description: Paste any public link, get the file.

Shell.legal: Personal use only. Download what you own, what is public domain or openly licensed, or what the site allows.

nav.label: Main

Home.title: Paste any link, get the file
Home.subtitle: Direct file links work today. Videos, archive.org, books and more are coming.
Home.pasteHint: One link, or many (one per line). You can also drop a .txt file here.
Home.notALink: That doesn't look like a link. Try something like https://example.com/file.pdf
Home.clipboardDenied: The browser didn't allow reading the clipboard. Paste with Ctrl+V instead.
Home.fileTooBig: That file is too big. Use a .txt list under 2 MB.
Home.noRecent: Nothing downloaded yet. Paste a link above to start.

Jobs.rejected: {count, plural, one {# link was skipped} other {# links were skipped}}

Errors.blocked_url: This link points to a private or local network address, or isn't http(s), so it can't be downloaded.
Errors.unsupported: This link isn't supported yet. Web pages and video sites come in later versions.
Errors.not_found: The server says this file doesn't exist.
Errors.upstream: The other server returned an error. Try again later.
Errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Errors.invalid_state: That action isn't possible right now.
Errors.checksum: The file was damaged in transfer (checksum mismatch). Try again.
Errors.incomplete: The download stopped before the end. Try again to resume.
Errors.unsafe_path: The file name wasn't safe to save.
Errors.drm: This is DRM-protected (paid streaming). AnyGet never downloads DRM content.
Errors.members_only: Only channel members can watch this. AnyGet does not get around that.
Errors.paid: This video must be bought or rented first. AnyGet does not get around that.
Errors.age_restricted: This video needs an age check. If you are signed in on your own account, add your cookies.txt in Settings.
Errors.login_required: The site wants you to sign in. You can add a cookies.txt from your own account in Settings.
Errors.bot_check: The site asked to confirm you're not a bot. Try again later, or add a cookies.txt from your own account in Settings.
Errors.geo_blocked: Not available in your region. AnyGet does not get around region blocks.
Errors.live_not_finished: This is a live or upcoming stream. Try again after it ends.
Errors.unavailable: This video is unavailable or was removed.
Errors.invalid_cookies: That isn't a cookies.txt file (Netscape format).
Errors.restricted: archive.org restricts access to this item, so it can't be downloaded.
Errors.borrow_only: This item can only be borrowed from archive.org's lending library. AnyGet does not get around that.

Downloads.title: Downloads
Downloads.subtitle: Everything you've queued, with live progress.

Media.title: YouTube and video sites
Media.subtitle: Videos, Shorts, playlists and channels from YouTube, Vimeo, Bilibili, SoundCloud and many more. Pick the quality, or just the audio.
Media.notMedia: That link isn't a video site. Use the Home page for direct file links.
Media.cookiesHint: Signed in to a site with your own account? <link>Add your cookies.txt in Settings</link> so downloads work the same as in your browser.
Media.legal: Only download your own videos, Creative Commons or other content you are allowed to save. Members-only, paid, DRM and region-blocked videos are never bypassed.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.subtitle: More settings arrive in a later version.
Settings.cookiesTitle: Cookies for sites you are signed in to
Settings.cookiesHelp: Export cookies.txt (Netscape format) from your own browser with a cookies extension, then upload it here. yt-dlp then sees what your account can see, such as age-checked videos.
Settings.cookiesLegal: Use only your own account. The file stays on this computer, is readable only by AnyGet, and is never shown again.
Settings.cookiesPresent: {count, plural, one {A cookies file with # cookie is saved} other {A cookies file with # cookies is saved}} ({date}).
Settings.cookiesTooBig: That file is too big (max 1 MB).

Archive.title: archive.org
Archive.subtitle: Search the Internet Archive and download whole items or just the files you want. Restricted and lending-library items are shown but never downloaded.
Archive.creator: Creator
Archive.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {{shown} results}}
Archive.noResults: Nothing found. Try fewer words or remove a filter.
Archive.etiquette: AnyGet downloads at most 2 files from archive.org at a time and slows down when asked, to be a polite guest.
Archive.borrowOnly: This item is in the lending library: it can only be borrowed and read on archive.org, not downloaded.
Archive.restrictedNote: Access to this item is restricted by archive.org, so it can't be downloaded.
